abilities.effect: Every 0.5 s, every other living enemy within 4 m gets a x1.3 walk-speed buff lasting 0.7 s, so it fades shortly after they leave the aura or she dies. She never buffs herself.
abilities.name: Speaker Aura
abilities.trigger: Continuous pulse while alive and surfaced (AerobicsAuntie.gd)

abilities.effect: 7 damage per slap every 0.5 s (2 hits per 1.0 s arm-swing loop).
abilities.name: Aerobic Slap

abilities.effect: 5 damage per hit every 1.0 s (1 hit per swing loop).
abilities.name: Siege
abilities.trigger: Within 1.3 m of the dais wall (inherited)

clipAnnotations.attack: 1.0 s loop at native 1.0x speed: 2 beats (right-arm swing slap at 0.25 s, left at 0.75 s); 1 plant bite per 0.5 s beat, 1 house hit per loop.
clipAnnotations.die: One-shot 1.8 s: startled arms-up, swoons and plops down, speaker tips over and its LEDs go out, both shrink away; then freed.
clipAnnotations.walk: 1.2 s loop at native 1.0x: dance-walk with a hop every 0.3 s, hips swaying, left arm pumping overhead, right hand towing the speaker; LED trim pulses on the 0.6 s beat.

lore: Her speaker's beat hurries every ghost around her. Silence her first.
mechanism: Support: a fragile Hungry Ghost (50 HP, 0.8 m/s) whose rolling speaker pulses an aura every aura_interval. Enemies inside aura_radius (squared-distance check, scan skipped when she is alone) receive HungryGhost.apply_speed_buff(aura_speed_mult, aura_buff_duration); the duration slightly exceeds the interval so the buff ends shortly after they leave or she dies. She does not buff herself. Weak bites (7 per 0.5 s) and siege (5 per 1.0 s). All march/seek/eat/siege AI, health bar and materials inherited.
name: Aerobics Auntie
